title: Home on one screen
problem: Home scrolls: the stall, the mode cards, the goals and the Stamp book and Wardrobe tiles do not fit one phone screen.
scope: The stall card and a Your next goals card swipe together in one row (dots, arrows or swipe)
Stamp book and Wardrobe become labelled icon buttons on the stall card; their tiles are removed
The mode cards (Play, Market League, Daily market) are made compact so the whole Home fits 390x844 and 360x640 without scrolling; at 320x568 as close as possible
How to play, Settings and Account stay reachable
exclusions: No rule, save or mode change

acceptance.text: Screens at 390, 360 and 320: no vertical scroll at 390 and 360

approval.evidence: Owner, 2026-11-22: "remove the your next goals, create it into a swipeable card which swipes with the stall, remove stamp book and wardrobe but make it into a button icon at the stall card so player can easily access the item; point of this exercise is to make everything fit into one page"
